# Auto-Farm Vault

{% embed url="<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uXRPLoBSiLM>" %}

**Auto-Farm Vault** is Krystal’s next-generation liquidity farming vault that combines a flexible vault interface, advanced automation, and an AI Agent to help users farm yield across DeFi with zero manual effort.

Instead of managing pools, ranges, rebalances, and reward compounding by hand, users simply define their farming goals — and the vault, powered by Krystal’s AI Agent, takes care of everything.

Auto-Farm Vault is built for users who want to maximize yield while staying hands-free.

***

#### 🚀 A New Kind of Vault

Auto-Farm Vault enhances the traditional vault model with greater flexibility and control:

* **Private by design**\
  Each Auto-Farm Vault is owned by a single user. Other users cannot deposit into it, giving the owner full freedom to customize strategies, risk levels, and assets without being affected by shared liquidity.
* **No principal token restriction**\
  Unlike traditional shared vaults that are tied to a fixed principal token, Auto-Farm Vault removes this limitation. Users can farm **any pool or pair** within the vault, enabling true multi-asset and cross-pool strategies under one vault.

This turns the vault into a personal farming engine rather than a one-size-fits-all product.

***

#### 🤖 AI Agent at the Core

At the heart of Auto-Farm Vault is Krystal’s **AI Farming Agent** — the star of the system.

The AI Agent:

* Understands liquidity pools, APRs, rewards, and risks
* Monitors market conditions and pool performance in real time
* Executes actions such as providing liquidity, rebalancing, harvesting, compounding, and exiting when needed

Users simply give the Agent instructions about what they want, for example:

> “Farm stable pools with low IL.”\
> “Maximize APR on ETH pairs.”\
> “Move funds if yield drops below 15%.”

From there, the AI Agent:

* Selects suitable pools
* Deploys capital
* Manages LP positions end-to-end — **completely hands-free**

***

#### 🌟 In Short

Auto-Farm Vault brings together:

* A **private, flexible vault** structure
* **Multi-pool, multi-asset** farming without principal token limits
* An **AI Agent** that plans and executes LP strategies automatically

All in one place — so users can focus on outcomes, while Krystal handles the complexity.
